# Thunderbird app-option relocation required the matching Gecko option contract

The Thunderbird mail-only configuration move removes MOZ_APP_NAME and MOZ_APP_PROFILE from confvars.sh and sets them with imply_option in moz.configure. Full Bug 1951143 and D239871 explain the integration prerequisite: the earlier build error allowed MOZ_APP_PROFILE from confvars only, and the reland waited for the separate Gecko project_flag change D240162. The Gecko implementation was not independently inspected, so this is attributed historical integration rationale, not a verified global configure rule. At fixed0b93 the profile value varies by platform and enterprise; do not replace those conditions with the historical lowercase value. No build or configure run here. Discussion URLs: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1951143 and https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D239871.

Scope: mail build identity configuration.
